title: IdeaSeek parsed-paper artifact (parsed-paper-v1)
description: Structural contract for the parsed-paper artifact shared by the Python worker (pdf/OCR), the LaTeX parser and every TS reader (extract rehydration, search, evidence). Single authority: Python emits this shape, TypeScript validates it at the persistence boundary and on read. Extra per-parser fields (ocr, title, sectionCount) are allowed; semantic checks (page/text usefulness) stay with consumers.
